tree.heading: Prohibitions.—
tree.text: Except as provided in subsection (b), an American Great Lakes vessel may not be used to—

children.text: from a port in the United States that is not located on the Great Lakes; or
between ports in the United States;
transport bulk cargo (as defined in section 40102 of this title) that is subject to section 55305 or 55314 of this title or section 2631 of title 10; or
provide a service (except ocean freight service) as—
a common carrier on a fixed advertised schedule offering frequent sailings at regular intervals in the foreign trade of the United States.

tree.heading: Off-Season Exception.—
tree.text: An American Great Lakes vessel may be used for not more than 90 days during any 12-month period to engage in trade prohibited by subsection (a)(1)(A), except during the Great Lakes shipping season.
